item.title: Vatican tracks major companies to measure ethical investment
item.description: Catholics looking to align their investment portfolios with Catholic teaching now have some help from the Vatican. Source: NCR Online.

item.title: Archbishop Richard Moth installed in Westminster
item.description: Archbishop Richard Moth was solemnly installed as Archbishop of Westminster in a Mass at Westminster Cathedral on Saturday, succeeding Cardinal Vincent Nichols as leader of the Catholic Church in England and Wales. Source: The Tablet.

item.title: Pope prays for victims of deadly Madagascar cyclones
item.description: Pope Leo yesterday prayed for victims of two deadly cyclones in Madagascar and their families and asked that the upcoming Lunar New Year opens a future of peace and bridge-building. Source: Crux.

item.title: Young Men of God movement prepares for comeback
item.description: After several years of limited activity, the Young Men of God movement is seeking to re-establish itself as a formative ministry for young Catholic men in Australia. Source: National Centre for Evangelisation.

item.title: Young tradies building a future for themselves
item.description: Four young tradespeople have marked a major milestone, graduating from their apprenticeships with St Joseph Affordable Homes, a Hobart Archdiocese social enterprise designed to address housing affordability and youth employment in Tasmania.

item.title: More than 4000 Walk for Life in Adelaide
item.description: The witness to the infinite value and dignity of every human life from conception to natural death must continue in our society, writes Adelaide Archdiocese’s Vicar General, Fr Dean Marin. Source: The Southern Cross.

item.title: Cross’s pilgrimage a ‘moving embrace’ from God
item.description: The Migrant Jubilee Cross, which is making its way around Australia, has officially started its pilgrimage around Melbourne. Source: Melbourne Catholic.

item.title: Taylor vows to ‘fight for our nation’ and ‘stay true’ to Liberal values
item.description: Angus Taylor has vowed to “fight for our nation” as Opposition Leader after toppling Sussan Ley in the Liberal Party’s leadership spill. Source: Canberra Times.

item.title: Pope urges Lenten ‘fast’ from words that wound
item.description: In his message for Lent, Pope Leo XIV urges Catholics to listen more closely to God and others – and to “disarm” their language by fasting from words that wound. Source: EWTN News.
